assessment: Using unbiased transcriptional profiling, the study reports a fundamental discovery of FincoR, a novel hepatic lncRNA generated from an enhancer element, which plays a role in FXR biology. The convincing findings have therapeutic implications in the treatment of MASH. The authors use state-of-the-art methodology and use unbiased transcriptomic profiling and epigenetic profiling, including validation in mouse models and human samples.
